dialogSubtitle: A few quick steps and you are ready to start.

storage.title: Choose a storage location
storage.desc: Videos, subtitles, and offline models all live in the same folder.
storage.unavailable: This folder is not usable right now. Please pick another one.
storage.note: Offline models are large (hundreds of MB to over 1 GB), so pick a location with plenty of space. You can change it later in Settings → Storage.

models.manualGuideTitle: Download not working? Manual install guide
models.manualStep1: 1. Open the link below in your browser and download:

download.title: Download offline resources
download.desc: Download once — pronunciation, subtitles and translation keep working even when you are offline.
download.note: Downloads can be resumed if interrupted. You can also do this later in Settings → Services & Models.

done.title: You're all set!
done.desc: Setup is complete. Here are two quick tips to get you started.

tutorial.title: How to Open Videos & Subtitles
tutorial.desc: Master the two most convenient ways to import media and start learning:
tutorial.method1Desc: Click 'Open Folder' on the home page and select a directory containing your videos and subtitles. DashPlayer links them automatically.
tutorial.method1Tip: 💡 Tip: Keep video and subtitle files in the same folder with matching names, e.g. movie.mp4 and movie.srt.
tutorial.method2Title: Method 2: Multi-select video and subtitle files
tutorial.method2Desc: Click 'Open File', then in the system file picker hold Ctrl / Command to select both the video file (.mp4/.mkv, etc.) and the subtitle file (.srt/.vtt, etc.).
tutorial.method2Tip: 💡 Tip: Selecting both at once automatically binds the subtitles and loads the player.
